mapper.select: SELECT team_id FROM nw_chat_user_teams WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND channel_id=#{channel} AND client_ref=#{clientRef}::uuid ORDER BY created_at

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_chat_user_teams t JOIN nw_chat_client_profiles p USING(tenant_id,channel_id,client_ref) JOIN nw_end_users u ON u.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND u.id=p.end_user_id AND u.status='active' WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.channel_id=#{channel} AND t.team_id=#{team} AND p.end_user_id::text=#{endUser})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_channel_agent_bindings b JOIN nw_channels c ON c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.id=b.channel_id AND c.status='active' JOIN nw_agents a ON a.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND a.id=b.agent_id AND a.status='published' WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.channel_id=#{channel} AND a.id::text=#{agent})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_chat_user_teams WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND channel_id=#{channel} AND client_ref=#{clientRef}::uuid AND team_id=#{team})
